article.headline: Davis, LIU beat UNC Wilmington 115-114 in 2OT
article.description: — Daquan Davis led LIU with 26 points, including the game-winning free throw with three seconds left in double overtime, and the Sharks defeated UNC Wilmington 115-114 on Wednesday.

article.story: NEW YORK -- — Daquan Davis led LIU with 26 points, including the game-winning free throw with three seconds left in double overtime, and the Sharks defeated UNC Wilmington 115-114 on Wednesday. Davis also contributed six assists for the Sharks (1-6). Jakhi Howard added 25 points and eight rebounds. Kamari Jones finished with 20 points. The win snapped a six-game losing streak for the Sharks. Tahlan Pettway finished with 25 points, five assists and five steals for the Seahawks (4-1). UNC Wilmington also got 24 points and 15 rebounds from Patrick Wessler. Tyler Nelson also had 16 points, eight rebounds and two blocks. LIU entered halftime up 51-48. Davis paced the team in scoring in the first half with 12 points. LIU was outscored by three points in the second half as the teams ended regulation tied 93-93. Up next LIU next plays Sunday against Fairfield at home, and UNC Wilmington will visit Norfolk State on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
